## Send a Message

```{=html}
<!--
  To activate this form, create a free account at https://formspree.io,
  create a new form, and replace YOUR_FORM_ID in the action URL below.
-->
<form
  id="contact-form"
  action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID"
  method="POST"
  novalidate
  class="contact-form"
>
  <div class="cf-group">
    <label for="cf-name" class="cf-label">Name <span class="cf-required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <input
      type="text"
      id="cf-name"
      name="name"
      class="cf-control"
      placeholder="Your full name"
      required
      autocomplete="name"
    />
    <div class="cf-invalid-feedback">Please enter your name.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="cf-group">
    <label for="cf-email" class="cf-label">Email <span class="cf-required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <input
      type="email"
      id="cf-email"
      name="email"
      class="cf-control"
      placeholder="you@example.com"
      required
      autocomplete="email"
    />
    <div class="cf-invalid-feedback">Please enter a valid email address.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="cf-group">
    <label for="cf-subject" class="cf-label">Subject <span class="cf-required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <select id="cf-subject" name="subject" class="cf-control" required>
      <option value="" disabled selected>Select a topic…</option>
      <option value="Course Inquiry">Course Inquiry</option>
      <option value="Research Collaboration">Research Collaboration</option>
      <option value="Mentoring / Advising">Mentoring / Advising</option>
      <option value="Media / Press">Media / Press</option>
      <option value="General Question">General Question</option>
      <option value="Other">Other</option>
    </select>
    <div class="cf-invalid-feedback">Please select a subject.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="cf-group">
    <label for="cf-message" class="cf-label">Message <span class="cf-required" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <textarea
      id="cf-message"
      name="message"
      class="cf-control"
      rows="6"
      placeholder="Your message…"
      required
    ></textarea>
    <div class="cf-invalid-feedback">Please enter your message.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Honeypot anti-spam field – hidden from real users -->
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />

  <div id="cf-status" class="cf-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <button type="submit" class="cf-btn" id="cf-submit">
    <span class="cf-btn-text">Send Message</span>
    <span class="cf-btn-icon bi bi-send" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </button>
</form>

<script>
(function () {
  var form    = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  var status  = document.getElementById('cf-status');
  var btn     = document.getElementById('cf-submit');

  if (!form) return;

  /* Basic client-side validation feedback */
  function showError(input) {
    input.classList.add('cf-invalid');
    var fb = input.parentElement.querySelector('.cf-invalid-feedback');
    if (fb) fb.style.display = 'block';
  }
  function clearError(input) {
    input.classList.remove('cf-invalid');
    var fb = input.parentElement.querySelector('.cf-invalid-feedback');
    if (fb) fb.style.display = '';
  }

  form.querySelectorAll('.cf-control').forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('input', function () { clearError(el); });
    el.addEventListener('change', function () { clearError(el); });
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var valid = true;
    form.querySelectorAll('[required]').forEach(function (el) {
      /* Use the browser's built-in validity check for all field types */
      if (!el.validity.valid) { showError(el); valid = false; }
    });
    if (!valid) return;

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.querySelector('.cf-btn-text').textContent = 'Sending…';

    var data = new FormData(form);
    fetch(form.action, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: data,
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
    })
    .then(function (res) {
      if (res.ok) {
        status.className = 'cf-status cf-status--success';
        status.textContent = '✓ Your message was sent! I\u2019ll get back to you as soon as possible.';
        form.reset();
      } else {
        return res.json().then(function (json) {
          var msg = (json.errors && json.errors.map(function (e) { return e.message; }).join(', ')) ||
                    json.error ||
                    'Submission failed (HTTP ' + res.status + ').';
          throw new Error(msg);
        });
      }
    })
    .catch(function (err) {
      status.className = 'cf-status cf-status--error';
      status.textContent = '✗ ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again or email me directly.');
    })
    .finally(function () {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.querySelector('.cf-btn-text').textContent = 'Send Message';
      status.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
